question: curious to know if anyone is aware of using the API to collect DBT all JOB run history information. I want to collect all the history of failed DBT jobs for a particular period.
title: How to collect DBT JOB run history information using the API call?
answer:
There is one file run_results.json generated during each run under folder /target/run_results.json. Parse it and get both success or error result for each model.

We can save the /target/run_results.json after each run as history. Use it for further processing for statistics specially for production environment.
